Shell(npx tsx -e  import { previewSpeechSarvam } from './src/modules/calling/sarvam.tts'; async function simulateCall() { // Simulate a real inbound call conversation (4-turn dialogue) const turns = [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are speaking live on a phone call. Reply in 1 short sentence, 5-15 words. Answer from FAQ. Match the customer language. No markdown. No emoji. Call request_human only when asked for agent.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Hello, aapke business hours kya hain?' }, { role: 'assistant', content: 'We are open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM IST.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'OK, mujhe kisi se complaint karni hai' }, { role: 'assistant', content: '' }, ]; // Test the brain with multi-turn context const start = Date.now(); const res = await fetch('https://api.sarvam.ai/v1/chat/completions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'api-subscription-key': 'sk_9abwlg04_hGtdFvIgJlrV0NEwhyv3lxJ2', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'sarvam-105b-conversations', messages: turns, max_tokens: 200, temperature: 0.5, frequency_penalty: 0.1, tools: [ { type: 'function', function: { name: 'request_human', description: 'Customer wants agent', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { reason: { type: 'string' }, urgency: { type: 'string', enum: ['normal','urgent'] } }, required: ['reason'] } } }, { type: 'function', function: { name: 'schedule_callback', description: 'Schedule callback', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { when: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['when'] } } } ], tool_choice: 'auto' }) }); const j = await res.json(); const brainMs = Date.now() - start; const tc = j.choices?.[0]?.message?.tool_calls; const content = j.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '(empty)'; console.log('Brain response (' + brainMs + 'ms):', content); console.log('Tool calls:', tc ? tc[0].function.name : 'none'); // Now test TTS for the response (only if there's text content) if (content && content !== '(empty)') { const ttsStart = Date.now(); const audio = await previewSpeechSarvam(content.slice(0, 200), { speaker: 'shubh', language: 'hi-IN' }); console.log('TTS latency:', Date.now() - ttsStart, 'ms'); console.log('Audio generated:', audio.audioBase64.length, 'bytes'); } else if (tc) { // Tool call was returned — test the 'connecting you' message const ttsStart = Date.now(); const audio = await previewSpeechSarvam('Please hold — let me connect you with our team.', { speaker: 'shubh', language: 'hi-IN' }); console.log('Hold message TTS:', Date.now() - ttsStart, 'ms'); console.log('Audio:', audio.audioBase64.length, 'bytes'); } console.log('\n✅ Full voice pipeline simulation complete'); } simulateCall().catch(e => console.error('FAIL:', e.message));  2 >& 1)
